items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What Charlie out in the West? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: What Charlie out in the West?

items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You made a recording with Charlie Parker. That’s right?

ctx.x: keys—they do that, piano players, when they’re playing—raise my hand. Don’t touch a note. Then come right in. He said, “I never seen nobody do that. That’s what you call respect.” And I gets that from “The Lion” in front of a gang of people. Not a gang of people. About six critical musicians.
You recorded with quite a few people, a range of people from . . . You did radio broadcasts with Louis Armstrong. You made a recording with Charlie Parker. That’s right?
